name: output-voltage-tc
description: Vref accuracy at every PVT corner plus the box-method temperature coefficient over an internal 1 degC-step -40..125 degC sweep.
claim: README.md 'Target specification (RATIFIED 2026-07-31)' -> rows 'Output reference' (1.20 V +/-2% untrimmed, i.e. 1.176-1.224 V) and 'Temp coefficient (-40..125 degC)' (< 50 ppm/degC, box method). TC convention: (Vref_max - Vref_min)/(Vref_27C * 165 degC) * 1e6, with Vref_max/Vref_min taken over a fine internal temperature sweep -- `dc temp -40 125 1`, i.e. 1 degC steps / 166 points at every process and supply point -- NOT over the three-point outer temperature axis, so the parabolic curvature peak is captured wherever it falls. The accuracy row is claimed here only in its process/temperature/supply-corner sense; that row's 3-sigma untrimmed mismatch portion is verified by the Monte Carlo bench (#13). Caveat carried by every record from this bench until #10 lands: bandgap_amp is the provisional, un-offset-budgeted 5T OTA from #8 (design/bandgap_operating_point.md 4.1), so a FAIL here is a statement about that provisional sizing, not about the achievability of the ratified target.

vref.description: RATIFIED spec: output reference 1.20 V +/-2% untrimmed. Corner portion only -- the mismatch/3-sigma portion of the same row is #13.

tc_ppm.description: RATIFIED spec: temperature coefficient < 50 ppm/degC, box method over -40..125 degC. Computed from the internal 1 degC sweep, not from the three outer temperature points.

sweep_points.description: Not a spec check: asserts the internal temperature sweep really ran -40..125 degC in 1 degC steps (166 points). This is what makes index 0 = -40 degC, index 67 = 27 degC and index 165 = 125 degC true, so the box, the endpoint columns and the TC denominator all mean what the Claim says. sim/run_suite.py cross-checks the same thing a second, independent way: vref_m40/vref_27/vref_125 from the internal sweep must match the outer-axis operating points at -40/27/125 degC.
